# THE STILLHOUSE

> THE STILLHOUSE is a 28-room boutique retreat above the Great Rift Valley at Naivasha, Kenya - a quieter kind of extraordinary. Three room types: the Garden Room (KSh 28,000/night), the Valley Suite (KSh 52,500) and the Signature Retreat (KSh 81,300). Bookings are held for a limited window and settled via M-Pesa.

The property is laid out around a still pool and kitchen garden, with dining, story and experience content written for guests who want unhurried days above the valley. Distances, prices and availability are indicative; the booking flow is the source of truth for live rates.

## Stay

- [Rooms and rates](/rooms): Garden Room, Valley Suite and Signature Retreat, with plans and inclusions.
- [Check availability and book](/availability): pick dates, party size and room, then review and confirm.
- [Experiences](/experiences): guided walks, pool mornings, private dining and valley excursions.
- [Dining](/dining): breakfast, lunch, and a quiet room for dinner.

- [Our story](/story): the building, the landscape and why we keep things still.
